<style>
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Allura&family=Bodoni+Moda:ital,opsz,wght@0,6..96,400;0,6..96,600;0,6..96,700;1,6..96,400;1,6..96,500&family=DM+Sans:opsz,wght@9..40,400;9..40,500;9..40,600&family=Poppins:wght@300;400;500&display=swap');
/* Old Flavia identity (Bodoni, Allura, gingham, arches, FP monogram, pastels) + editorial scroll motion. Scoped under .fc */
.fc{--cream:#F6F0EA;--blush:#F6E6E5;--pink:#FEC6D3;--sky:#BAD4ED;--ice:#DAE9F7;--crimson:#A10728;--oxblood:#720808;--ink:#3B1216;--soft:#7A5258;--white:#FFFDFB;
--display:"Bodoni Moda","Didot","Times New Roman",serif;--body:"DM Sans","Helvetica Neue",Arial,sans-serif;--label:"Poppins","Helvetica Neue",Arial,sans-serif;--script:"Allura","Snell Roundhand",cursive;--gutter:clamp(16px,4vw,64px);
background:var(--cream);color:var(--ink);font-family:var(--body);font-size:17px;line-height:1.65;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;overflow-x:clip;color-scheme:light}
.fc *,.fc *::before,.fc *::after{box-sizing:border-box}
.fc img,.fc video{display:block;max-width:100%}
.fc a{color:inherit}
.fc p{margin:0}
.fc h1,.fc h2,.fc h3{font-family:var(--display)!important;font-weight:400!important;text-transform:none!important;letter-spacing:-.015em!important;margin:0;color:var(--crimson)!important;text-wrap:balance}
.fc h1 em,.fc h2 em,.fc h3 em{font-style:italic;color:inherit}
.fc :focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--crimson);outline-offset:3px}
.fc .wrap{padding-inline:var(--gutter)}
.fc section,.fc #oferta{scroll-margin-top:96px}
.fc .inner{max-width:1220px;margin-inline:auto}
.fc .label{font-family:var(--label);font-weight:400;font-size:.72rem;letter-spacing:.3em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--crimson)}
.fc .script{font-family:var(--script);color:var(--crimson);font-size:2.6rem;line-height:1}
.fc .rule{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:1.4rem;justify-content:center}
.fc .rule::before,.fc .rule::after{content:"";height:1px;background:currentColor;flex:1;max-width:220px;opacity:.5}
.fc .btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.6em;font-family:var(--label);font-size:.74rem;letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;background:var(--crimson);color:var(--blush);border:1px solid var(--crimson);border-radius:999px;padding:1.05rem 2rem;text-decoration:none;transition:background .25s,color .25s,transform .25s}
.fc .btn:hover{background:var(--oxblood);border-color:var(--oxblood);transform:translateY(-2px)}
.fc .btn.ghost{background:transparent;color:var(--crimson)}
.fc .btn.ghost:hover{background:var(--crimson);color:var(--blush)}
.fc .btn.light{background:var(--blush);color:var(--crimson);border-color:var(--blush)}
.fc .btn.light:hover{background:var(--pink);border-color:var(--pink)}
.fc .btn.line{background:transparent;color:var(--blush);border-color:var(--blush)}
.fc .btn.line:hover{background:var(--blush);color:var(--crimson)}
.fc .cta-row{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.8rem}
.fc .gingham{background-color:var(--white);background-image:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(186,212,237,.55) 50%,transparent 50%),linear-gradient(rgba(186,212,237,.55) 50%,transparent 50%);background-size:28px 28px}
.fc .stripes{background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,var(--ice) 0 26px,var(--white) 26px 52px)}
.fc .arch{overflow:hidden;border-radius:999px 999px 18px 18px}
.fc .arch img,.fc .arch video{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.fc mark{background:linear-gradient(transparent 58%,var(--pink) 58%);color:inherit;padding:0 .1em}
.fc .mono{width:86px;height:86px;border-radius:28px;display:grid;place-items:center;position:relative;font-family:var(--display);font-style:italic;color:var(--crimson);background:var(--pink);flex:none}
.fc .mono b{font-weight:400;font-size:3.1rem;line-height:1;position:absolute;left:18px;top:8px}
.fc .mono i{font-size:3.1rem;line-height:1;position:absolute;right:16px;bottom:6px}
.fc .mono small{position:absolute;top:40px;left:0;right:0;text-align:center;font-family:var(--label);font-style:normal;font-size:.42rem;letter-spacing:.2em}
.fc .mono.dark{background:var(--crimson);color:var(--blush)}
.fc .card{border-radius:36px;padding:clamp(28px,3.6vw,48px);text-align:center;display:grid;gap:1.05rem;align-content:start;justify-items:center;transition:transform .35s ease,box-shadow .35s ease}
.fc .card:hover{transform:translateY(-6px) rotate(-.4deg);box-shadow:0 22px 44px rgba(114,8,8,.12)}
.fc .card h3{font-size:clamp(2rem,3vw,2.7rem)!important;line-height:1.05!important}
.fc .card.white{background:var(--white)}.fc .card.pink{background:var(--pink)}.fc .card.sky{background:var(--sky)}.fc .card.blush{background:var(--blush)}
.fc .price{font-family:var(--display);font-style:normal;font-weight:700;font-variation-settings:"opsz" 11;font-size:2.5rem;line-height:1;letter-spacing:-.01em;color:var(--crimson)}
.fc .rate{font-size:.95rem;color:var(--soft);margin-top:-.4rem}
.fc .sec-head{text-align:center;display:grid;gap:1rem;justify-items:center;margin-bottom:clamp(36px,5vw,60px)}
.fc .sec-head h2{font-size:clamp(2.6rem,5.4vw,4.8rem)!important;line-height:1.04!important}
.fc .sec-head p{max-width:34rem}
.fc .cards3{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:20px;max-width:1140px;margin-inline:auto}
.fc .cards2{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.2fr) minmax(0,.8fr);gap:22px;max-width:1040px;margin-inline:auto}
.fc .sec{padding-block:clamp(72px,9vw,124px)}
.fc .cards1{display:grid;max-width:620px;margin-inline:auto}
.fc .ch-days{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;justify-content:center;margin:0 auto clamp(28px,4vw,44px)}
.fc .ch-days span{background:var(--white);border-radius:999px;padding:.5rem 1rem;font-family:var(--label);font-size:.64rem;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--crimson)}
.fc .card ul.ticks{list-style:none;padding:0;margin:0;display:grid;gap:.55rem;text-align:left;max-width:30rem}
.fc .card ul.ticks li{padding-left:1.5em;position:relative}
.fc .card ul.ticks li::before{content:"\2713";position:absolute;left:0;color:var(--crimson);font-weight:700}
.fc-reels-intro{position:relative;background:var(--crimson);color:var(--blush);text-align:center;padding-block:clamp(80px,10vw,140px);overflow:hidden;border-top:10px solid var(--pink)}
.fc-reels-intro::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background-image:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(254,198,211,.07) 50%,transparent 50%),linear-gradient(rgba(254,198,211,.07) 50%,transparent 50%);background-size:34px 34px;pointer-events:none}
.fc-reels-intro .inner{position:relative;display:grid;gap:1.3rem;justify-items:center;max-width:820px}
.fc-reels-intro .label{color:var(--pink)}
.fc-reels-intro h2{font-size:clamp(3.2rem,8vw,7rem)!important;line-height:1!important;color:var(--blush)!important}
.fc-reels-intro h2 em{color:var(--pink)!important}
.fc-reels-intro p{max-width:46ch}
.fc-reels-intro .mono{rotate:-6deg;animation:fc-wob 6s ease-in-out infinite}
.fc .cards-yago{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:20px;max-width:900px;margin-inline:auto}
.fc .card .note{font-size:.88rem;color:var(--soft);margin-top:-.3rem}

/* header: old ticker + logo, new fixed bar that turns crimson + full-screen menu */
.fc-top{position:fixed;inset:0 0 auto 0;z-index:60}
.fc-ann{background:var(--crimson);color:var(--blush);overflow:hidden;transition:margin-top .35s}
.fc-ann-track{display:flex;width:max-content;font-family:var(--label);font-size:.68rem;letter-spacing:.24em;text-transform:uppercase;padding-block:.55rem;animation:fc-slide 40s linear infinite}
.fc-ann-track span{padding-inline:2.2rem;white-space:nowrap}
.fc-ann-track span::after{content:"✦";margin-left:4.4rem;opacity:.7}
.fc-bar{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:12px var(--gutter);transition:background .35s,box-shadow .35s,color .35s;color:var(--crimson)}
.fc-top.is-scrolled .fc-bar{background:var(--crimson);color:var(--blush);box-shadow:0 8px 26px rgba(114,8,8,.18)}
.fc-logo{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:.08em;text-decoration:none;font-family:var(--display);font-size:1.9rem;line-height:1;white-space:nowrap}
.fc-logo b{font-weight:600}
.fc-logo::after{content:"✦";font-size:.5em;position:relative;top:-.9em;margin-left:.05em}
.fc-menu-btn{width:60px;height:60px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid currentColor;background:transparent;color:inherit;font-family:var(--label);font-size:.6rem;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;cursor:pointer;transition:background .25s,color .25s}
.fc-menu-btn:hover{background:var(--crimson);color:var(--blush);border-color:var(--crimson)}
.fc-top.is-scrolled .fc-menu-btn:hover{background:var(--blush);color:var(--crimson)}
.fc-nav{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:55;background:var(--crimson);color:var(--blush);display:grid;place-content:center;gap:.2rem;text-align:center;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .4s;overflow:hidden}
.fc-nav::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background-image:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(254,198,211,.08) 50%,transparent 50%),linear-gradient(rgba(254,198,211,.08) 50%,transparent 50%);background-size:40px 40px;pointer-events:none}
.fc[data-open="true"] .fc-nav{opacity:1;pointer-events:auto}
.fc-nav a{position:relative;font-family:var(--display);font-size:clamp(2.4rem,6.6vw,4.6rem);text-decoration:none;line-height:1.12;transform:translateY(20px);opacity:0;transition:transform .5s,opacity .5s,color .25s}
.fc[data-open="true"] .fc-nav a{transform:none;opacity:1}
.fc[data-open="true"] .fc-nav a:nth-child(2){transition-delay:.05s}.fc[data-open="true"] .fc-nav a:nth-child(3){transition-delay:.1s}.fc[data-open="true"] .fc-nav a:nth-child(4){transition-delay:.15s}.fc[data-open="true"] .fc-nav a:nth-child(5){transition-delay:.2s}.fc[data-open="true"] .fc-nav a:nth-child(6){transition-delay:.25s}
.fc-nav a em{font-style:italic}
.fc-nav a:hover{color:var(--pink)}
.fc-nav .script{color:var(--pink);font-size:3rem;margin-bottom:.6rem}

/* hero: giant name behind an arch photo, gingham panel, phone reel */
.fc-hero{position:relative;padding:150px var(--gutter) clamp(60px,7vw,100px);overflow:hidden}
.fc-hero-panel{position:absolute;left:50%;top:260px;bottom:40px;width:min(760px,86vw);translate:-50% 0;border-radius:40px;opacity:.9}
.fc-hero-title{position:relative;z-index:1;text-align:center;transform:translateY(var(--shift,0px)) scale(var(--scale,1));transform-origin:50% 0;will-change:transform}
.fc-hero-title .script{font-size:clamp(3rem,5.6vw,5.4rem);display:inline-block;rotate:-6deg;translate:-22% 18%;position:relative;z-index:3}
.fc-hero-title h1{font-size:clamp(6rem,21vw,19rem)!important;line-height:.82!important;letter-spacing:-.03em!important;white-space:nowrap}
.fc-hero-stage{position:relative;z-index:2;display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) clamp(300px,30vw,430px) minmax(0,1fr);gap:clamp(24px,4vw,64px);align-items:end;max-width:1300px;margin:clamp(-6rem,-5vw,-3rem) auto 0}
.fc-hero-copy{display:grid;gap:1.4rem;justify-items:start;padding-bottom:2rem}
.fc-hero-copy .tagline{font-family:var(--display);font-size:clamp(1.7rem,2.4vw,2.3rem);line-height:1.12;color:var(--oxblood)}
.fc-hero-copy .tagline em{color:var(--crimson)}
.fc-hero-copy .lede{max-width:24rem;font-size:1.04rem}
.fc-hero-copy .cta-row{flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start}
.fc-hero-art{position:relative}
.fc-hero-art .arch{aspect-ratio:3/4.15;border:9px solid var(--white);box-shadow:0 30px 60px rgba(114,8,8,.2)}
.fc-hero-art .arch img{transform:scale(var(--zoom,1.1));transform-origin:50% 30%}
.fc-hero-art .mono{position:absolute;right:-28px;bottom:9%;rotate:-8deg;box-shadow:0 10px 24px rgba(114,8,8,.18);animation:fc-wob 6s ease-in-out infinite}
.fc-tag{position:absolute;z-index:4;background:var(--white);color:var(--crimson);border-radius:999px;padding:.6rem 1.1rem;font-family:var(--label);font-size:.62rem;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;box-shadow:0 10px 22px rgba(114,8,8,.14);white-space:nowrap;animation:fc-bob 5s ease-in-out infinite}
.fc-tag.t1{left:-18%;top:16%;rotate:-6deg}
.fc-tag.t2{right:-22%;top:44%;rotate:5deg;background:var(--pink);animation-delay:-1.6s}
.fc-tag.t3{left:-10%;bottom:16%;rotate:-3deg;background:var(--sky);animation-delay:-3.2s}
.fc-hero-phone{justify-self:end;width:min(100%,250px);padding-bottom:1rem;rotate:5deg;transform:translateY(var(--phone,0px))}
.fc-vid-cap{font-family:var(--label);font-size:.6rem;letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--crimson);background:var(--white);border-radius:999px;padding:.55rem 1.05rem;width:max-content;margin:0 auto .9rem;box-shadow:0 6px 16px rgba(114,8,8,.12)}
.fc-vid-cap.on{background:var(--crimson);color:var(--blush)}
.fc-vid{position:relative;width:100%;aspect-ratio:9/16;border-radius:34px;overflow:hidden;border:9px solid #1B0B0D;box-shadow:0 30px 60px rgba(114,8,8,.25);background:#1B0B0D}
.fc-vid video{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.fc-sound{position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:16px;translate:-50% 0;z-index:5;font-family:var(--label);font-size:.58rem;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;background:var(--blush);color:var(--crimson);border:0;border-radius:999px;padding:.65rem 1.05rem;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 6px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.28);white-space:nowrap}

/* stats */
.fc-band{background:var(--sky);padding-block:clamp(48px,6vw,76px)}
.fc-band .label{margin-bottom:2.2rem;color:var(--oxblood)}
.fc-stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:1.5rem;text-align:center}
.fc-stats b{display:block;font-family:var(--display);font-weight:400;font-style:italic;color:var(--crimson);font-size:clamp(2.8rem,5.4vw,4.6rem);line-height:1;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.fc-stats span{display:block;margin-top:.6rem;font-family:var(--label);font-size:.68rem;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--oxblood)}

/* sticky manifesto with orbiting tiles */
.fc-mani{position:relative;height:210vh;background:var(--blush)}
.fc-mani-stick{position:sticky;top:0;height:100svh;display:grid;place-items:center;padding:120px var(--gutter) 60px;overflow:hidden}
.fc-mani-in{position:relative;z-index:2;max-width:940px;text-align:center;display:grid;gap:1.3rem;justify-items:center}
.fc-mani h2{font-size:clamp(3rem,7.4vw,6.8rem)!important;line-height:1!important}
.fc-mani h2 em{display:block;color:var(--oxblood)!important}
.fc-mani p.txt{max-width:60ch;font-size:clamp(1rem,1.25vw,1.1rem)}
.fc .fc-orb{position:absolute;width:clamp(70px,7.6vw,112px);aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:30px;display:grid;place-items:center;box-shadow:0 18px 40px rgba(114,8,8,.14);transform:translate(var(--ox,0px),var(--oy,0px)) rotate(var(--or,0deg));will-change:transform;overflow:hidden}
.fc-orb svg{width:44%;height:44%;stroke:var(--crimson);fill:none;stroke-width:1.6;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;position:relative}
.fc-orb.o1{left:7%;top:22%;width:clamp(76px,8vw,112px);height:auto}
.fc-orb.o2{right:8%;top:16%}
.fc-orb.o3{left:10%;bottom:14%}
.fc-orb.o4{right:9%;bottom:18%;background:var(--pink)}
.fc-orb.o1.mono{border-radius:30px}

/* numbered paths */
.fc-moves{background:var(--cream)}
.fc-move{display:grid;grid-template-columns:120px minmax(0,1fr) 260px;gap:clamp(20px,4vw,56px);align-items:center;padding:clamp(28px,4vw,46px) 0;border-top:1px solid rgba(161,7,40,.25);max-width:1140px;margin-inline:auto;text-decoration:none}
.fc-move:last-child{border-bottom:1px solid rgba(161,7,40,.25)}
.fc-move .n{font-family:var(--display);font-style:italic;font-size:clamp(3.4rem,6vw,5.6rem);color:var(--crimson);line-height:1;transition:transform .4s}
.fc-move:hover .n{transform:translateX(10px)}
.fc-move .txt{display:grid;gap:.7rem;justify-items:start}
.fc-move h3{font-size:clamp(2.2rem,3.8vw,3.4rem)!important;line-height:1!important}
.fc-move .go{font-family:var(--label);font-size:.7rem;letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--crimson);border-bottom:1px solid currentColor;padding-bottom:2px}
.fc-move .pic{aspect-ratio:4/5;border:7px solid var(--white);box-shadow:0 18px 40px rgba(114,8,8,.14);rotate:var(--tilt,0deg);transition:rotate .5s,transform .5s}
.fc-move:hover .pic{rotate:0deg;transform:scale(1.04)}

/* AI split */
.fc-split{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;min-height:92vh}
.fc-split-img{position:relative;overflow:hidden;min-height:440px}
.fc-split-img{perspective:1800px;background-color:var(--blush);background-image:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(186,212,237,.5) 50%,transparent 50%),linear-gradient(rgba(186,212,237,.5) 50%,transparent 50%);background-size:28px 28px}
.fc-flip{position:absolute;inset:0;transform-style:preserve-3d;transform:scale(var(--fs,1)) rotateY(var(--flip,0deg));will-change:transform}
.fc-face{position:absolute;inset:0;overflow:hidden;backface-visibility:hidden;-webkit-backface-visibility:hidden}
.fc-face.back{transform:rotateY(180deg)}
.fc-face img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.fc-face.back img{object-position:50% 20%}
.fc-face-tag{position:absolute;left:24px;top:24px;background:var(--white);color:var(--crimson);border-radius:999px;padding:.55rem 1.05rem;font-family:var(--label);font-size:.62rem;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(114,8,8,.18)}
.fc-face.back .fc-face-tag{background:var(--crimson);color:var(--blush)}
.fc-split-img .mono{position:absolute;right:28px;bottom:28px;rotate:8deg;z-index:2}
.fc-split-txt{position:relative;background:var(--crimson);color:var(--blush);display:grid;align-content:center;gap:1.2rem;padding:clamp(44px,7vw,110px) clamp(24px,6vw,96px);overflow:hidden}
.fc-split-txt::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background-image:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(254,198,211,.07) 50%,transparent 50%),linear-gradient(rgba(254,198,211,.07) 50%,transparent 50%);background-size:34px 34px;pointer-events:none}
.fc-split-txt>*{position:relative}
.fc-split-txt .label{color:var(--pink)}
.fc-split-txt h2{font-size:clamp(2.8rem,5.4vw,5rem)!important;line-height:1.02!important;color:var(--blush)!important}
.fc-split-txt h2 em{color:var(--pink)!important}
.fc-split-txt p{max-width:44ch}
.fc-split-txt .price{color:var(--blush);font-size:3rem}
.fc-split-txt .rate{color:var(--pink)}

/* marquee */
.fc-marq{background:var(--crimson);color:var(--blush);overflow:hidden}
.fc-marq.pink{background:var(--pink);color:var(--crimson)}
.fc-marq-track{display:flex;width:max-content;font-family:var(--display);font-style:italic;font-size:clamp(1.6rem,3vw,2.5rem);padding-block:1.2rem;animation:fc-slide 32s linear infinite}
.fc-marq-track span{padding-inline:2.4rem;white-space:nowrap}
.fc-marq-track span::after{content:"✦";font-style:normal;font-size:.6em;margin-left:4.8rem;vertical-align:middle}

/* pain */
.fc-pain-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:18px;max-width:980px;margin-inline:auto}
.fc-pain-card{background:var(--white);border-radius:28px;padding:1.8rem 1.6rem;display:flex;gap:1.1rem;align-items:flex-start;transition:transform .3s}
.fc-pain-card:hover{transform:translateY(-4px)}
.fc-pain-card .n{font-family:var(--display);font-style:italic;font-size:2.6rem;line-height:1;color:var(--crimson);flex:none;width:2rem}
.fc-pain-card p{font-size:1.06rem;line-height:1.55}
.fc-pain-end{max-width:42rem;margin:clamp(40px,5vw,60px) auto 0;text-align:center;display:grid;gap:.8rem;justify-items:center}
.fc-pain-end .big{font-family:var(--display);font-size:clamp(1.5rem,2.4vw,2.05rem);line-height:1.32;color:var(--oxblood)}

/* before / after */
.fc-ba{background:var(--pink);position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.fc-ba-row{display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;gap:clamp(24px,5vw,64px);margin-top:clamp(20px,3vw,36px)}
.fc-ba-row .ph{width:min(64vw,250px)}
.fc-ba-row .ph.raw{rotate:-4deg}.fc-ba-row .ph.done{rotate:3deg}
